feeds.title: Ecns.cn
feeds.description: Ecns.cn is the official English-language website of China News Service (CNS), providing latest news, comments, analysis, photos and videos on China society, business, culture, sci-tech, sports, entertainment and travel.

feeds.title: China Digital Times
feeds.description: China Digital Times (CDT) is an independent, bilingual media organization that brings uncensored news and online voices from China to the world. CDT's companion site, China Digital Space, is a comprehensive, bilingual guide to online political discourse, state censorship practices, news events, and public opinion in Chinese cyberspace.

feeds.title: CarNewsChina
feeds.description: CarNewsChina.com is the leading portal for news, analysis, and information about the Chinese auto industry. It was founded in Beijing in April 2010 by Tycho de Feijter and stands stronger than ever today.

feeds.title: BBC News » China
feeds.description: Get the latest news from BBC News which includes breaking news, features, analysis and special reports plus audio and video

feeds.title: The Diplomat » China
feeds.description: The Diplomat is a current-affairs magazine for the Asia-Pacific, with news and analysis on politics, security, business, technology and life across the region.

feeds.title: China Underground
feeds.description: Get Closer to China: here you will find the latest news, images, movies, books, travel, media, art and history of China.

feeds.title: US-China Perception Monitor
feeds.description: The US-China Perception Monitor aggregates the most pertinent news on US-China relations, focusing on how each country perceives the other.

feeds.title: China Environment Net
feeds.description: China Environment Net is a web-based service that curates news, information, and analysis on the green policies and ecological actions of China on the full range of domestic and international environmental issues, including news on the delivery of environmental infrastructure projects through China's Belt and Road Initiative.

feeds.title: The New York Times » China
feeds.description: Unlock the story of China. Browse The New York Times's breaking news and extensive historical coverage on China here.

feeds.title: ChinaFile
feeds.description: China File is an online magazine publishing, showcasing, and contributing to the best reporting and commentary on China published by Asia Society's Center on U.S.-China Relations .Find China News, Analysis, Culture, Environment, Media on this website

feeds.title: Beijing Bulletin
feeds.description: Beijing Bulletin is an online newspaper focused on the national capital of China. The site features a wealth of local news, as well as content covering surrounding areas and analysis of the latest political news coming out of this power hub.

feeds.title: China Entertainment News
feeds.description: China Entertainment News covers movie, music, television, fashion and celebrity news shaping China's Entertainment industry.

feeds.title: China Film Insider
feeds.description: China Film Insider is an entertainment news source that reports on the impact China and Hollywood have on each other and the rest of the world.

feeds.title: Rand » China
feeds.description: RAND focuses on the issues that matter most such as health, education, national security, international affairs, law and business, the environment, and more.RAND's China experts have examined a wide range of issues, including the country's military, political, and trade relations, especially with Taiwan and Japan.

feeds.title: Justrecently's Weblog
feeds.description: Find news about China on this website.

feeds.title: Young's China Business Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring commentary on the latest developments for Chinese companies listed in the US, Hong Kong and China

feeds.title: Wild East Football
feeds.description: A website about Chinese football, in English. Wild East Football offers news, views and analysis of Chinese football in English from a fairly unique perspective.

feeds.title: China in WW2
feeds.description: News about the 1931-1945 Sino-Japanese war and the birth of modern Asia by Peter Harmsen, author of New York Times bestseller 'Shanghai 1937' and 'Nanjing 1937'

feeds.title: China Copyright and Media
feeds.description: The aim of China Copyright and Media is to be an online resource providing access to and insight in Chinese law and policy regarding public communication. Currently, it contains a blog and an expanding China Media Law Database. In the future, this will be supplemented by topical issue papers and case analysis.

feeds.title: China.org.cn
feeds.description: Let's start exploring China! China.org.cn offers broad access to up-to-date news about China, with searchable texts of government position papers and a wealth of basic information about Chinese history, politics, economics and culture.

feeds.title: China Military
feeds.description: The Only Official English-Language News Website of the Chinese People's Liberation Army(PLA), Featuring the Latest and Exclusive News and Information from the Chinese Military, Covering the PLA Army, Navy, Air Force, Rocket Force, and Strategic Support Force.

feeds.title: TechNode
feeds.description: Started in 2007 by Dr. Lu Gang, China-based TechNode is at the center of a unique worldwide tech ecosystem of startups, venture capital firms, industry resources, and corporate partners. We provide daily and weekly updates on the latest happenings and events in the Chinese tech space through articles, videos, podcasts, newsletters, and more.

feeds.title: China Briefing
feeds.description: China Briefing hosts a wealth of business intelligence on legal, tax, and operational issues in China from a practical perspective.

feeds.title: China Daily
feeds.description: China Daily is China's national English-language newspaper. We strives to be the world's window into China, while also capturing a holistic view of China's political, economic, social and cultural landscape.

feeds.title: China Internet Watch
feeds.description: China Internet Watch: CIW is a leading news source on China internet news, trends & insights covering search, social media, mobile...across various industries.

feeds.description: The China Africa Project is a multimedia resource dedicated to exploring every aspect of China's growing engagement with Africa.

feeds.description: I am an Italian qualified lawyer established in Shanghai, China since 2006, with a strong focus on food. This blog aims at sharing some useful knowledge about what is happening in Chinese food law, and how this is shaping the behavior of food-industry stakeholders.
